research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Riverbed Technology is researching systems for secure tokens in stateless software defined networking, focusing on initial configurations and cryptographically secure certificates for network device deployment. They are also developing methods for computing a digital experience index by analyzing metric data from monitored infrastructure, and applying machine learning to predict infrastructure health. These areas reflect efforts in network security, performance monitoring, and predictive analytics.

about_short_description.short_description: Riverbed Technology is an information technology company that develops network and application performance software.

product.name: Riverbed Platform
product.description: An open observability platform that combines telemetry, data management, AI, and automation to monitor and improve digital experiences across users, devices, applications, networks, and infrastructure.

product.name: Aternity
product.description: A digital experience management platform that monitors employee, customer, and mobile experiences across devices, applications, networks, and work environments.

product.name: Riverbed IQ
product.description: An AI-driven AIOps solution that correlates IT data, identifies anomalies and root causes, and supports proactive investigation and remediation of operational issues.

product.name: Riverbed Acceleration
product.description: A network and application acceleration portfolio that improves application delivery and data movement across cloud, branch, remote, and hybrid environments.

product.name: SteelHead
product.description: A WAN and application acceleration product that optimizes data transfers and application performance across distributed enterprise networks.

product.name: Network Observability
product.description: A set of monitoring and analysis capabilities for understanding network traffic, flows, packets, infrastructure health, and user experience across hybrid and multi-cloud networks.
